core_requests: P333: core cnj_process EntityType so CNJ numbers from gazette excerpts pivot as that type instead of KEYWORD (gazette_excerpts.cnj_pivot_args).
P238/P361: core `v3lum data import-rfb --names` (and the P238 importer) calls cnpj_name_resolver.build_from_rfb_import() after the import, never during a scan.
P361 FC3: move normalize_company_name (cnpj_name_resolver) and company_org/namematch.py into v3lum/core/namematch.py.
POL-14: let a module mark registered datasets optional so the resolver is not UNAVAILABLE 'dataset' until every CVM/BCB set is installed (same request as p1-G10-3).

AR16: enumerated purpose category in the case model (due_diligence, incident, employment_screening refused) readable from ctx, replacing the free-text purpose heuristics in querido_diario/djen_court_communications.
UI/CLI: interactive selection of expand=False pivots with relation possible_cnpj that starts the CNPJ chain on the chosen hypothesis (P361 FC6).
POL-12: narrow allowed_sources per provider when a provider needs contact_email, instead of skipping the whole module (forced the cnpj_name_resolver_wikidata companion).
Context: read-only access to facts already collected for the current entity (e.g. cnpj_lookup razao social) so querido_diario need not refetch /company/info.
P224: shared Wikidata client; cnpj_name_resolver._wikidata switches to it once it lands.
